Digital Signal Processing.notes:
The Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) converts a finite-length discrete-time signal from the time domain into the frequency domain.

DFT equation:
X(k) = Σ[n=0 to N-1] x(n)e^(-j2πkn/N)

The Inverse DFT converts frequency-domain values back to the time domain.

FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) is an efficient algorithm for calculating the DFT.

Important concepts:
1. DFT represents the frequency components of a discrete signal.
2. FFT computes the same DFT result more efficiently.
3. Direct DFT has O(N²) computational complexity.
4. Radix-2 FFT has O(N log₂N) complexity.
5. Twiddle factor is W_N^k = e^(-j2πk/N).
6. Butterfly operation is the basic computational unit of FFT.
7. DIT FFT means Decimation-in-Time FFT.
8. DIF FFT means Decimation-in-Frequency FFT.
9. FFT is used in signal analysis, audio processing, image processing and communication systems.
